summary: Short 15 m kerb at a junction, signed No Stopping Any Time.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 14-15 m away on the west side; others within 20 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is 15 m long at a junction mouth with a narrow lane; parked cars sit hard against the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy bend of Ryans Road at a junction.
drivers.convention: Two No Stopping Any Time signs at this kerb, although cars are parked there in imagery.

sun_shade: Tree shade over the south end; open to the west otherwise.
